name: SPELL-SCROLL-book-drawn-straight
why: the report itself: every pick draws the book from nothing and the list stands at its top

name: SPELL-SCROLL-page-unnamed
why: another spell's page opens at the last spell's offset

name: SPELL-SCROLL-page-keyed-by-nothing
why: a key that never changes is no key: the next spell's page keeps the last one's place

name: SPELL-SCROLL-page-keyed-by-row
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-2, the fault itself: a delete keeps `picked`, so the spell that takes a deleted one's row opens at its offset

name: SPELL-SCROLL-page-keyed-by-name
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-2: a key that is not the spell's identity - a rename throws the same spell's page to its top

name: SPELL-SCROLL-chronicle-drawn-straight
why: the sibling's fault: a card folded or a note removed throws the Chronicle's page to its top

name: SPELL-SCROLL-section-unnamed
why: another section opens at the last section's offset

name: SPELL-SCROLL-key-out-of-the-path
why: the helper reads no key: a pane that shows another thing keeps the old thing's place

name: SPELL-SCROLL-nothing-recorded
why: the helper records no scroll: every repaint through it stands its panes at the top (the survivor Testing.md gave tools/enhancedScrollProbe.mjs to kill, now killed in the suite)

name: SPELL-SCROLL-nothing-given-back
why: the offsets read and never put back

name: SPELL-SCROLL-key-own-step-only
new: const key = n === el ? n.getAttribute?.('data-scroll-key') : null;
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-1: a key names only the pane that carries it, never the panes inside it - the grimoire dress's Chronicle scrolls its .px-qdetail inside the keyed .px-body, and another section kept the last one's place

name: SPELL-SCROLL-found-unchecked
old: return pathOf(host, n).path === path ? n : null;
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-4: the element at the saved indices taken whatever it is - a pane that names another thing, or another tag or class in the same place, given the old offset

name: SPELL-SCROLL-tree-mapped
new: const el = new Map([...host.querySelectorAll('*')].map((x) => [pathOf(host, x).path, x])).get(path.path) ?? null;
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-4, the fault itself: the rebuilt tree mapped whole to find one pane - every element's path, each step a sibling list (~400 ms a fold in a Chronicle of 500 notes, scrolled); the same panes restored, so only the count of steps read kills it

name: SPELL-SCROLL-tree-searched-in-order
new: const el = [...host.querySelectorAll('*')].find((x) => pathOf(host, x).path === path.path) ?? null;
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-4: the tree searched element by element until the path is met - as cheap as the walk for a pane at the tree's head, the whole tree's paths for one after a long list

name: SPELL-SCROLL-the-body-scrolls-the-book
old: .sb-shell .px-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
why: the body's own overflow-y: auto back: one scroll for the list and the page

name: SPELL-SCROLL-the-journal-grows
why: the journal's min-height: 100% back: it grows with its rows past the body, and neither column scrolls

name: SPELL-SCROLL-the-columns-do-not-scroll
why: the page beside the list loses its own scroll (the rail keeps the journal's)

name: SPELL-SCROLL-body-overridden-after
old: .sb-shell .px-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
new: .sb-shell .px-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; } .sb-shell .px-body { overflow-y: auto; }
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-3: a later rule gives the body its one scroll back - the layout pin read the first rule, not the cascade

name: SPELL-SCROLL-journal-overridden-after
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-3: a later rule grows the journal with its rows again

name: SPELL-SCROLL-page-overridden-by-plus
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-3: Enhanced Plus's sheet, laid after the enhanced one, takes the page's own scroll away

name: SPELL-SCROLL-list-overridden-by-calm
old: export const UI_CALM_CSS = `/* UI-CALM (ui/uiCalmStyle.js) - laid after Enhanced Plus's sheet */
new: export const UI_CALM_CSS = `/* UI-CALM (ui/uiCalmStyle.js) - laid after Enhanced Plus's sheet */ .sb-shell .px-qrail { overflow: visible; }
why: AUDIT FB1018f L2-3: UI-calm's sheet, laid last, takes the list's own scroll away

name: SPELL-SCROLL-classic-click-scrolls
why: the classic book departing from ListBox.MouseClick: a pick moves the list
